gen-gf-offside-gf-allerta: A line that glides like wire, curves left open. Offside spaces its letters wide, and Allerta, a plain sans with loose tracking and a prominent x-height, carries on that open spacing below.
gen-gf-offside-gf-cal-sans: Curves that refuse to close, spaced wide and level. Cal Sans runs one stroke width through the whole alphabet, with short ascenders and a tall x-height that keep things friendly under the heading.
gen-gf-offside-gf-viga: Viga keeps its capitals barely taller than their neighbors, with strokes free of hairlines and shadows, beneath Offside's wide-set curves. Paragraphs would roll along smoothly, with no sharp edges to snag on.
gen-gf-offside-gf-winky-sans: Winky Sans keeps its capitals barely taller than lowercase. Offside's strokes hold their width from start to finish, so beneath it the sans-serif text hums along without anything shouting.
gen-gf-offside-outfit: Curves that refuse to close and widely tracked letters give Offside a quiet, level beat, with no accents of weight. Outfit runs lower in the lowercase and bends its strokes like cable.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-synonym: Big lowercase, uninterrupted monoline strokes, curves ending in clear daylight. Oxanium earns its keep large and brief, while Synonym lays down a constant stripe of ink with moderate lowercase height beneath it.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-st: Loud and expressive, Pixelify Sans holds a steady line weight, with a c as open as a bent paperclip. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std then adds a restrained swell to its curves.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-jost: Bold, steady-lined Pixelify Sans, its c open like a bent paperclip. Jost, a plain sans with broad terminal gaps, matches that uniform stroke, so both fonts speak in lines of unvarying width.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-suse-mono: Pixelify Sans holds a steady line weight, with no swelling or thinning, while SUSE Mono leaves extra space around every letter. That heading earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-ysabeau-sc: Pixelify Sans draws a steady, marker-like line, bold and expressive. Shrink that heading and the marker feel fades, or enlarge Ysabeau SC and its gaping c becomes impossible to miss.
